programs.title: Memorial May: WWII Battles 6
programs.desc: Witness the final battle for Europe. Colorized footage captures the brutal street-by-street fight for Berlin, the fall of the Nazi regime, and the courage of Allied forces who fought to bring World War II to its end.

programs.title: Memorial May: Apocalypse 1
programs.desc: Trace the origins of WWII, revealing how the rise of fascism and the failure to confront Hitler's early invasions led to global conflict and ignited the most devastating war in human history.

programs.title: Memorial May: Apocalypse 2
programs.desc: Nazi Germany storms across Western Europe, delivering devastating blows to Allied forces. From the fall of France to the evacuation at Dunkirk,watch how tactical superiority and unprepared resistance led to some of the war's darkest setbacks.

programs.title: Memorial May: Apocalypse 3
programs.desc: Experience the global spread of war as Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and Nazi forces invade the USSR. In the Pacific, Pearl Harbor thrusts the USA into conflict, jolting the balance of power and setting the stage for total war on every front.

programs.title: Memorial May: Apocalypse 4
programs.desc: As the conflict engulfs the globe, brutal fighting rages across North Africa, Eastern Europe, and the Pacific. There is a mounting toll on soldiers and civilians. Nazi atrocities escalate, while resistance movements grow in occupied territories.

programs.title: Memorial May: Apocalypse 5
programs.desc: Allies gain ground, the Axis powers begin to falter. Soviet forces push westward, the Allies liberate Rome, and D-Day marks the start of liberation of Western Europe. Hitler's grip is weakening, the noose tightens around Nazi Germany from all sides.
